fieldNotes.truckGate: Wide multi-lane controlled truck entrance off the east access drive; perimeter chain-link fence with Kroger sign visible in Street View; hatched lane markings and a checkpoint pinch-point at the booth.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white guard-booth structure (~1-vehicle footprint) sitting in the truck lane with yellow hatched markings around it at ~29.7834,-95.2700, beside the perimeter fence; visible at z21 and corroborated in Street View.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved entrance apron with room for multiple lanes / express bypass (seen in SV and z20 imagery).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on different building faces: long south-facing dock apron of the main building plus a separate east-facing dock face with trailer canopies.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer drop yard (hundreds of trailers in rows) on the SW of the property, plus a secondary east truck/trailer yard with private-fleet tractors.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur enters the NW corner of the property and runs SE through the site alongside the docks (visible in N/NW/E corner crops and in Street View foreground).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC building (very large, multi-wing white roof) is the primary structure; a smaller secondary building sits to the east of the rail/yard. Counted as 2; could be read as 1 large complex.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh platform clearly visible in the truck path; left false (flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding apron inside the entrance before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated from dock-canopy rhythm across the south and east faces; honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense northeast Houston industrial fabric inside the metro; classified Urban.
